title: Spectral Sidon Property of N-Body Choreography Distance Sets (rectified)
description: Test whether D_n = {2*sin(pi*m/n) : m=1..floor(n/2)} is a Sidon set in R
method: Exhaustive pairwise sum comparison with tolerance 1e-12 (v1 method preserved; v2 rectifies labeling only)

rectification.reviewer: Orthogonal team (Claude Code Skeptic + Perplexity sonar)
rectification.reason: v1 collision_identity_at_n30 field reported sin(pi/15)+sin(7*pi/15)=sin(2*pi/15)+sin(4*pi/15) (numerically FALSE: LHS approx 1.2024, RHS approx 1.1498). The boolean detection first_collision=30 is independently sound; the labeling string was wrong. Corrected to the genuine collision at indices m=(3,15) and m=(5,9) in S_30, provable from golden-ratio sin values.
rectification.scope: labeling-only correction; numerical detection results (collision_ns_3_to_200, gcd_of_collision_ns) carried forward from v1 unchanged but flagged for re-verification before any external publication
rectification.v1_status: RETAINED READ-ONLY per H2 invariant Rule 3 (results never overwritten)

results.collision_identity_at_n30_provable_from_: Real.cos_pi_div_five = (1 + sqrt(5))/4, Real.sin_pi_div_two = 1, Real.sin_pi_div_six = 1/2; sin(pi/10) = cos(2*pi/5) and sin(3*pi/10) = cos(pi/5) via Real.sin_pi_div_two_sub; cos(2x) = 2cos^2(x) - 1 via Real.cos_two_mul

theorem_candidate: For 3 <= n <= 29, D_n is a Sidon set in R. (Finite verification, 27 cases. Currently axiomatized in SpectralSidonScratch/SpectralSidon.lean pending native_decide proof.)
conjecture_status: FLAGGED: Perplexity (2026-04-28) found NO literature confirming n=30 as the smallest Sidon-failing N for this multiset family. The conjecture 'all collisions at n divisible by 6' is local to this experiment and not externally validated. Treat as research hypothesis, not established result.
n_body_interpretation: All known stable choreographies (n <= ~20) live in the Sidon regime. An n=30 Sidon failure exists; whether n=30 is the THRESHOLD (smallest such N) is open pending exhaustive re-verification.
connection_to_erdos_30: The compiled Lean proof of sidon_sum_count (|A|*(|A|+1)/2 <= 2*sup(A)+1) applies directly: for D_n with n<=29, the Sidon bound constrains the spectral distance space of choreographies.
pass_fail: PASS (LABELING-CORRECTED) — Sidon property holds empirically for n=3..29; an n=30 Sidon failure exists. Threshold-claim demoted to conjecture pending re-verification.
publication_status: BLOCKED — do not cite externally until full re-run from scratch confirms collision_ns list independently of v1 pipeline.
